labels.idle: Hands are not working on the task. Starts when the last contact ends and stops when a reach begins.
labels.reach: Hand moves toward an object. Starts at the first motion toward it and ends at first contact.
labels.grasp: Fingers close on the object. Starts at first contact and ends when the object leaves its surface.
labels.transport: The object moves through the air. Starts at lift-off and ends when it first touches its destination.
labels.place: The object is set down and adjusted. Starts at first touch on the destination and ends when the fingers begin to open.
labels.release: Fingers open and withdraw. Starts when the fingers begin to open and ends when contact is fully lost.
